args.description: top-down view of a village square floor: a 4 by 4 grid of 16 small square paving tiles with thin dark joints between them, each tile a patch of wet grey cobblestones, every tile different: a small puddle, mud between the stones, a grass tuft, a fallen leaf, plain wet cobbles, moss

front view of a village house wall section: timber frame and white plaster with dark wooden beams, a small shuttered window, a mossy thatched roof edge along the top, rainy dusk, dark fantasy pixel art

front view of a flat wall surface filling the whole picture, seen straight on, no doorway, no sky, no floor: timber frame and white plaster with dark wooden beams, a mossy thatched roof edge along the top, with a warm glowing lantern hanging on the wall in the middle, dark fantasy pixel art
front view of a narrow wooden timber post with a hanging lantern
top-down view of a uniform seamless tileable texture of wet thatched straw, no objects, no border, filling the whole picture
an iron street lamp post with a warm glowing lantern on top, dark fantasy pixel art dungeon prop
a round hay bale tied with rope, dark fantasy pixel art dungeon prop
a wooden rain barrel full of water, dark fantasy pixel art dungeon prop
a small wooden window with warm light inside and open shutters, front view, wall decoration, dark fantasy pixel art
climbing ivy leaves on a wall, front view, wall decoration, dark fantasy pixel art
top-down sprite sheet of small separate floor things on a transparent background, spaced apart: fallen autumn leaves, small puddles, a mud splash, a horseshoe, straw bits, a lost boot, pebbles
